body.statement: There is a deterministic bit-polynomial-time algorithm which factors any nonzero polynomial in \(\mathbb Q[x]\) into primitive irreducible integer factors and their multiplicities.

source.verbatim_statement: Given a non-zero polynomial \(f\in\mathbb Q[X]\) in one variable with rational coefficients, find the decomposition of \(f\) into irreducible factors in \(\mathbb Q[X]\).

attestation.note: Transcribed from Lenstra, Lenstra, and Lovasz, Factoring Polynomials with Rational Coefficients.
